name: arXiv 2605.10453: SlimSpec: Low-Rank Draft LM-Head for Accelerated Speculative Decoding
notes: Paper by Anton Plaksin, Sergei Krutikov, Sergei Skvortsov, Alexander Samarin (Nebius). Investigates draft LM-head projection bottleneck in auxiliary-head drafters (EAGLE-3). Evaluates low-rank LM head compression across batch 1 and batch 64 regimes on LLaMA 3.1 8B, GPT-OSS 20B, and Qwen3-30B-A3B.
